newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus jails Iranian woman for drugs possession.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus jails Iranian woman for drugs possession.

text.p: An Iranian woman was jailed for five years by a Cypriot court on Friday after being found guilty of trying to smuggle cannabis into the island early this year.
Zahra Ali Ghozi, 53, from Tehran, was arrested shortly after her arrival to Cyprus in January at Larnaca airport. Police found cannabis resin in one of her bags weighing 1.7 kilos.
Ghozi had pleaded not guilty, saying the bag was given to her to bring to Cyprus by a woman in Tehran.
